history: Professional car-care and value-added services at OEM dealerships marked the beginning of our journey.
Our dealership experience became a dedicated Mr. Detailer studio in Jammu.
We expanded into Paint Protection Film and advanced surface-protection solutions.
A second studio brought together broader capabilities and a growing community of customers.
We continue to grow through customer trust, partnerships and an ambition to build a trusted network of detailing studios.

faqs.q: Where should I begin if I am unsure what to choose?
faqs.a: Tell the studio what you would like to feel differently when driving. Your vehicle and priorities can guide the assessment without choosing parts in advance.

faqs.q: Can you assess more than one service together?
faqs.a: Yes. Select the services you are considering in the enquiry form, and describe any existing modifications.

faqs.q: Will a modification affect my manufacturer warranty?
faqs.a: Implications depend on the vehicle and proposed work. Discuss the applicable terms before proceeding.

faqs.q: Is the preferred date a confirmed appointment?
faqs.a: No. The enquiry opens in WhatsApp or email for you to send. The studio will confirm availability and the next steps.

faqs.q: What happens during an assessment?
faqs.a: We review the vehicle’s condition, discuss your priorities and confirm suitable work, realistic outcomes and expected timing.

faqs.q: Will every scratch or stain disappear?
faqs.a: No. Depth, material and surface condition determine what can safely be improved. Existing damage is assessed before treatment.

faqs.q: Can I add PPF or coatings?
faqs.a: Yes, discuss them separately. PPF and coatings are not included in these detailing packages unless expressly agreed.

faqs.q: What about heavily soiled interiors?
faqs.a: Tell the studio about stains, pet hair or other concerns before the visit. Extra work and timing are confirmed after assessment.

faqs.q: Which vehicles can I enquire for?

faqs.q: How do I choose between Ceramic, Graphene and Borophene?
faqs.a: Compare each package’s stated benefits, protection period, inclusions. Ask the studio to recommend a suitable product for your vehicle condition and care preferences.

faqs.q: Does every package include the same treatments?
faqs.a: All listed packages include preparation, paint correction, polishing, coating application and interior detailing. Alloy, plastic, windshield and leather treatments vary by package. Check the selected package’s inclusion list.

faqs.q: What do the 1, 2, 3 and 5-year labels mean?
faqs.a: These are the protection periods shown in the catalogue. Applicable warranty coverage depends on the selected product, its terms and the required maintenance schedule.

faqs.q: How do I know which package suits my vehicle?
faqs.a: Share your vehicle make, model, year and paint condition with the studio. We can discuss the coating options, required preparation and suitable treatments.

faqs.q: Can I customise only a few details?
faqs.a: Yes. Start with selected accents or components and discuss their suitability with the studio.

faqs.q: Will the moodboard show my finished car?
faqs.a: No. It expresses a style direction only. The vehicle image is unchanged. Actual design, fitment and finish are agreed separately.

faqs.q: Will modifications affect warranty or compliance?
faqs.a: Some changes may affect vehicle warranty, insurance, registration or permitted use. Ask the studio to review the proposed changes and confirm relevant requirements before work.

posts.title: PPF or coating? Start with your priorities.
posts.desc: Understand their different roles before choosing protection.
sections: Two different approaches
PPF adds a physical film over suitable surfaces. A coating is a surface treatment. Neither choice should be made on a product name alone.
Start with your concern
Tell the studio whether your priority is exposed paintwork, appearance, cleaning or a particular finish. Discuss how you drive, park and wash the vehicle.
Ask for the details
Compare the selected product’s specifications, preparation requirements, coverage and written warranty. Coatings do not replace film’s physical barrier, and neither makes a vehicle damage-proof.

posts.title: Your first wash after protection.
posts.desc: Timing, tools and the instructions that matter most.
sections: Follow your handover instructions
Mr. Detailer’s usual first-wash guidance is 5–6 days. Confirm the waiting period for your particular film or coating; the selected product’s instructions take priority.
Keep the method gentle
Use clean microfibre cloths, suitable shampoo and the washing method recommended by the studio. Ask before using unfamiliar chemicals or accessories.
Keep up with care
A new finish still needs maintenance. Keep your care instructions and service records together, and ask about the required schedule.

posts.title: Gloss, matte or colour: find your PPF finish.
posts.desc: A starting point for comparing looks and real samples.
sections: Choose your appearance
Clear gloss keeps the original colour visible with a gloss appearance. Clear matte offers a less reflective look. Black and colour films can create a different visual direction.
See a physical sample
Screens and lighting affect appearance. Compare a real sample with your paint and discuss the areas you want covered.
Look beyond the finish
Ask about the individual film’s specifications, care requirements and warranty. A finish name alone does not explain its protection performance.

posts.title: Paint enhancement or paint correction?
posts.desc: How the catalogue’s one-step and two-step packages differ.
sections: Enhancement focuses on the finish
The Paint Enhancement package lists a one-step polish, a gloss boost and exterior sealant protection, alongside cleaning and care services.
Correction starts with assessment
The Paint Correction package lists two-step correction for paint with suitable swirls or light defects. The team must assess what can safely be improved.
Set realistic expectations
Deep scratches or damaged paint may need a different approach. Review the scope and expected result before work begins.

posts.title: A cleaner cabin starts with the right questions.
posts.desc: Tell the studio what your interior needs before treatment.
sections: Describe the concern
Mention stains, pet hair, odours and heavily used areas. Share photos if they help explain what you see.
Match care to the material
Fabric, leather and decorative trims may require different cleaning methods. Tell the team about any existing damage, treatments or sensitive areas.
Confirm the scope
The Interior Care package includes vacuuming, upholstery, dashboard, trims, vents, glass, odour treatment and dressing. Outcomes depend on condition; not every stain or odour can be eliminated.

faqs.q: How is detailing different from a wash?
faqs.a: A wash focuses on cleaning. A detailing visit can include deeper cleaning, surface-specific care and suitable paint enhancement, depending on the agreed scope.

faqs.q: Will every stain or scratch disappear?
faqs.a: No. Outcomes depend on the material, condition and depth of damage. We assess what can reasonably be improved before treatment.

faqs.q: Is paint correction included in every package?
faqs.a: No. The Paint Correction package lists two-step correction; Paint Enhancement lists a one-step polish. Other packages do not automatically include correction. The studio assesses suitability before proceeding.

faqs.q: How long should I leave my vehicle?
faqs.a: Timing depends on its size, condition and selected services. We’ll confirm an estimate after reviewing the vehicle.

faqs.q: Does a package include PPF or coatings?
faqs.a: These detailing packages do not include PPF or coating plans. Explore them separately if you want to discuss longer-term surface protection.

faqs.q: Do I need detailing experience?
faqs.a: Share your background with the team. Training needs and partner suitability are discussed during the review; experience requirements depend on the proposed role and model.

faqs.q: Can I propose my own city or property?
faqs.a: Yes. Include the city and property status in your enquiry. Location suitability and territory availability require review.

faqs.q: What services can a studio offer?
faqs.a: The catalogue includes PPF, Ceramic, Graphene and Borophene coatings, paint correction and detailing. The approved service scope depends on the model, setup and agreement.

faqs.q: What about investment and commercial terms?
faqs.a: The team will discuss setup requirements and commercial terms after understanding your proposed model and location. Final terms belong in a written proposal and agreement.

faqs.q: Does an enquiry guarantee a franchise?
faqs.a: No. This is the first step in a discussion. Partner selection, property approval and any agreement require review by Mr. Detailer.

faqs.q: Which package should I choose?

faqs.q: Will polishing remove every scratch?
faqs.a: The outcome depends on scratch depth and paint condition. Paint Correction addresses suitable swirls and light scratches; deeper damage may require repair or repainting.

faqs.q: Is sealant the same as a ceramic coating?
faqs.a: Sealant is included in the two paint-care packages. Ceramic, Graphene and Borophene coatings are separate services with their own preparation and product options.

faqs.q: How do I arrange a visit?

faqs.q: Does every product have the same warranty?
faqs.a: No. Use the warranty issued for your selected product and installation. A catalogue maximum duration does not confirm your individual coverage.

faqs.q: What maintenance is required?
faqs.a: Follow the written maintenance schedule. Mr. Detailer’s stated terms require annual free service; missing it cancels the warranty. Confirm the requirements recorded for your product with the studio.

faqs.q: What is excluded?
faqs.a: The catalogue excludes damage from accidents, misuse, negligence and improper care. The written warranty contains the complete exclusions.

faqs.q: Can I transfer my warranty?
faqs.a: The catalogue describes the warranty as non-transferable. Ask the studio to confirm the terms of your issued warranty.

faqs.q: Can this demo activate or check my warranty?
faqs.a: No. It prepares a request for the studio. Real registration, status checks, certificates and reminders require a connected warranty system.
